purpose: Test persistence and category dependence of early routing concentration, not final language quality
primary_diagnostics: Effective experts per layer in each 32-update interval
Normalized mutual information between input pool and selected expert
Paired held-out NLL differences across initialization seeds
controls: Same frozen windows and order for all runs; identical common initial weights within each seed pair; native routing semantics unchanged
limitations: One local data sample, short context, no balancing auxiliary loss, no language-quality claim; free softmax and uniform routing differ in mixture normalization
